To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have verified by explicit calculation, at 2-loop order in QCD, the cancellation of interactions of soft gluons with spectator partons in the Drell Yan process, and that this cancellation is a consequence of gauge invariance and of the fact that the gluon propagator is a transverse quantity.
the cancellation of soft spectator interactions with the hard parton in the Drell–Yan process is verified to 2-loop level, and that the cancellation is complete to 2-loop accuracy.
the soft interaction of a spectator with an active parton in the Drell Yan process, to 2 loop order, cancels in the sum of the two diagrams.
